SCENARIOS FOR THE DECEMBER 8–9 FED MEETING
Scenario2Y30YCurveTLTDollarStocksCryptoIn short
Fed hikes by 0.25
small
↘ slightly flatter
/
If the market expected this, the move is small; what the Fed says about the coming months (the projections) matters more.
Fed hikes by 0.50
(or ↓ if the market fears a recession)
↘ flatter
Hawkish surprise: money gets more expensive, risk assets suffer the most.
Fed leaves rates unchanged
(or ↑ if the market fears inflation)
↗ steeper
Dovish surprise, if the market expected a hike.
The market reacts to the surprise, not to the decision. If a hike was already expected, it is already priced in. The reaction also depends on the Fed’s message and on the economic projections published at this meeting.

* Bull = yields fall (TLT ↑), bear = yields rise (TLT ↓). Flattening = the gap between long and short narrows, steepening = it widens. The move matters, not the level.
